headline: Oman Import Prices Rise 11.7% Driven by Fuel Cost Increases
summary: Oman's import prices jumped 11.7% on the back of rising global fuel and transport costs, adding to domestic import-cost pressures.
why: Gulf economies are sensitive to imported inflation across consumer and industrial categories despite being net hydrocarbon exporters. High import prices squeeze non-oil corporate margins.

impacts.name: Oman
impacts.why: A double-digit jump in import costs elevates local wholesale pricing and places pressure on consumer price indexes.
